summary.text: Don Roberts is the Republican candidate for Ohio State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney who has practiced in domestic and juvenile courts, he ran unsuccessfully for a Franklin County judgeship in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Don Roberts was the unsuccessful challenger to incumbent Kim A. Browne in the November 8, 2022, general election for Franklin County Court of Common Pleas Domestic Relations and Juvenile Division.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey for that race, he said he had practiced primarily in domestic and juvenile courts for about 20 years.
He also described himself in that survey as an Air Force veteran, a former police officer and a former courtroom bailiff.
